messages.subject: Introductory resources for moderation, mediation and moderated mediation etc
parts: Dear forum members, I have read through the tutorials on the package website, but I am very much new to these statistical approaches and to the package. Are there any tutorial papers/books you would recommend in particular?

http://quantpsy.org/medn.htm

And the many papers provided on that site.  There is also some lavaan code for different moderated-mediation models with our preprint, although the paper is focused on simulating data from such models:
